ड: ड The third letter of the cerebral class of consonants, having the sound of D, pronounced far back in the “head”: it is often con-founded in pronounciation with a hard R, or L, sounded as in the Northumbrian bur; it is written in the Roman character D.

ड m. (-डः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Fear. 	 3. Sound. 	 4. Submarine fire. 5. A kind of drum or tabor. 	 6. A kind of bird. 	 f. (-डा) 	 1. A kind of female imp or goblin. 	 2. A basket, &c. carried by a sling: see डलक.  E. डप to collect, affix, ड.
डङ्गरी: डङ्गरी f. (-री) A kind of gourd; also read डङ्गारी  E. डं त्रासं गिरति गॄ-अच् गौरा ङीष् । कर्कटीभेदे ।
डप: डप r. 10th cl (डापयते) (इ) डपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्प-ते डम्पयते) To collect, to accumulate, to heap together. संहतौ वा-चुरा-आत्म-अक-सक-सेट् पक्षे भ्वा ।
डब: डब r. 10th cl. (इ) डबि (डम्बयति-ते) To throw, to send, to order. With वि prefixed, to deceive, to disgrace. चुरा-उभ-प-आत्मप्रेरणे राशिकरणे च । सक-सेट् ।
डभ: डभ (इ) डभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्भति डम्भययि-ते) To collect, to heap. together. चुरा-उभ-पस-सक-सेट् पक्षे भ्वा । इदित् ।
डम: डम m. (-मः) A man of low caste, employed to clear away filth, &c. E. डं तासं माति मा-क । (डोम्)
डमर: डमर mf. (-रः-रा) 	 1. An affray, a conflict without weapons. 	 2. Terri-fying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 	 3. Petty or predatory warfare, war carried on by detachments or by villagers, one in which kings are not engaged. 	 4. Rout, riot. 	 n. (-रं) Flight. run-ning away through fear.  E. डम् imitative sound, and अर what occa-sions, from ऋ to go, affix घञर्थे क ।
डमरु: डमरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. A musical instrument, a sort of small drum, shaped like an hour-glass, and held in one hand usually carried by Kapa-likas. 	 2. Any thing surprising, any strange occurence, &c.  E. डम imitative sound, ऋ to go or get उण् affix and the vowel changed.
डम्बर: डम्बर adj. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. Famous, Renowned. 	 2. (m) An assemblage, a mass. as in गेघडम्वर ।
डयन: डयन n. (-नं) 	 1. A car or litter carried upon men's shoulders, a Palan-quin, a Duli. 	 2. Flying in the air, the flight of a bird.  E. डी to fly aff ल्युट्.
डलक: डलक n. (-कं) A sling, a basket, a duli carried on mens’ shoulders by means of a stick and ropes like the beam and strings of a balance; presents of fruit, sweetmeats, &c. are usually sent in this manner; also read डल्लक. (डालि)
डहु: डहु m. (-हुः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.)  E. दह् to burn, affix उ, and deriv. irr.; also with ऊ affix डहू m. (-हूः).
डाकिनी: डाकिनी f. (-नी) A kind of female imp or evil being. डाकानां समूहः इनि ।
डाङ्कृति: डाङ्कृति f. (-तिः) The clang of a bell, ding-dong.
डामर: डामर m. (-रः) 	 1. Affray, conflict without weapons, &c. See डमर. 	 2. Rout, uproar, the bustle and the confusion of festivity or strife. 3. Any surprising thing, sight or occurrence. 	 4. A name common to six Tantras, as the Sivadamara, Yogadamara, Durgada mara, f. (-रा) 	 1. Terrific. 	 2. Beautiful. 	 3. Variegated &c.  E. डमर q. v. and अण् aff.
डालिम: डालिम m. (-मः) A pomegranate: see दाडिम.
डाहल: डाहल m. (-लः) The name of a country; also Tripura: see त्रिपुर.
डाहुक: डाहुक m. (-कः) A gallinule.  E. दह to consume, (disease,) उकञ् affix, the flesh being considered medicinal: the radical initial is changed.
डिङ्गर: डिङ्गर m. (-रः) 	 1. Throwing, sending. 	 2. A fat man. 	 3. A servant, a slave. 	 4. A rogue, a cheat. 	 5. A low or depraved man.
डिण्डिम: डिण्डिम m. (-मः) 	 1. A musical instrument, a kind of small drum or tabor. 	 2. A plant, bearing a small fruit, (Carissa carandas:) (पानआमला) see कृष्णपाक.  E. डिण्डि imitative sound, a din, and म what emits, from मि, with ड aff.
डिण्डिर: डिण्डिर m. (-रः) 	 1. Cuttle-fish bone, considered to be the foam of the sea. 	 2. A foam in general also. डिण्डीर ।
डित्थ: डित्थ m. (-त्थः) 	 1. Wodden elephant. 	 2. An agreeable man. “श्यामरूपो युवा विद्वान् सुन्दरः प्रियदर्शनः । सर्व्वशास्त्रार्थावेत्ता च डित्थ इत्यभिधीयते ॥
डिप: डिप r. 4th cl. (इर) डिपिर (डिप्यति) r. 6th cl. (डिपति) and r. 10th cl. (डेप-यति-ते) To throw, to cast, to send or order, to direct प्रेरणे वा चुरा-उभ-पक्षे तुदा कुटा० पर-सक-सेट् । see टिप r. 10th cl. (डेपयति-ते) also (इ) डिपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्पति) and (डिम्पय-ति-ते) To collect, to heap to gether. संहतौ वा चुरा उभ, पक्षे भ्वा-आत्म-अक-सेट् ।
डिब: डिब r. 10th cl. (इ) डिबि (डिम्बयति-ते) To cast, to throw. प्रेरणे वा चुरा उभ पक्षे भ्वा-पर-सक सेट् इदित् ।
डिभ: डिभ (इ) डिभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्भति and डिम्मयति-ते) To collect to heap together.
डिम: डिम m. (-मः) A dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle or seige, such as the Tripurabadha, in which the destruction of the three cities of TRIPURA by SIVA is dramatised.  E. डिम affray, and affix क 2. One of the ten kinds of drama, thus defined:--मायेन्द्र-जालसंग्रामक्रोधोद्भान्तादिचेष्टितैः । उपरागैश्च भूयिष्ठो डिमः ख्यातोऽतिवृत्तकः ॥
डिम्ब: डिम्ब m. (-म्बः) 	 1. Affray, assault. conflict without weapons mutual de-fiance, petty and predatory war, &c. See डमर. 	 2. Sound or noise occasioned by terror. 	 3. An egg. 	 4. A chrysalis. 	 5. The bladder. 6. The spleen. 	 7. The uterus. 	 8. Fear, terror. 	 9. Any young ani-mal. 	 10. A globe or ball.  E. डिबि घञ् अच् वा ।
डिम्बाहव: डिम्बाहव m. (-वः) Petty warfare, affray. skirmish, riot, &c.  E. डिम्ब as above, and आहव war, battle; also डिम्बयुद्ध and other similar compounds.
डिम्बिका: डिम्बिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bubble. 	 2. A kind of waterfly. 	 3. A libidinous woman.  E. डिम्ब the bladder, &c. कन् aff, or डिवि-ण्वुल् ।
डिम्प्र: डिम्प्र m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Any young animal. 	 2. A fool, an idiot, a blockhead. f. (-म्भा) An infant.  E. डिभि to collect, affix अच्; कन् being added; also डिम्भक.
डिम्भचक्र: डिम्भचक्र n. (-क्रं) A diagram for telling fortunes.
डी: डी (ङ) डीञ् r. 1st and 4th cls. (डयते डीयते) 	 1. To fly, to pass through the air. 	 2. To go, to move. With अव, prefixed, To fly down, to to alight. With उत्, To fly up, to soar. With परि, To fly round. With प्र, To fly well or swiftly. With सम्, To fly well or in flocks. With सम् and उत्, To fly up by degrees. नभोगतौ भ्वा० दिवा० आत्म० सक० सेट् ।
डीन: डीन n. (-नं) Flying, the flight of a bird, to go.  E. डी to fly, भ्वावे क्त ।
डीनडीनक: डीनडीनक m. (-कः) Flying reiteratedly.  E. डीन flying, reduplicated, कन् added.
डीनावडीन: डीनावडीन n. (-नं) 	 1. Flying up and down. 	 2. Flying ill.  E. डीन, and अवडीन alighting.
डुण्डु: डुण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A kind of snake, (Amphisbæna)
डुण्डुभ: डुण्डुभ m. (-भः) A kind of snake, not poisonous. (Amphisbæna) E. डुण्डु, and भ from भा to shine or resemble. डुण्डु इत्यनुकरणशब्दं भणति तेन भाति वा भण भा वा ड (ढोडासाप) ।
डुन्दुक: डुन्दुक m. (-कः) A gallinule: see डाहुक.
डुलि: डुलि f. (-लिः) 	 1. A small turtle. 	 2. A female turtle: see टुलि.
डुलिका: डुलिका f. (-का) A bird resembling a wagtail.
डोर: डोर n. (-रं) A fillet of thread or cord tied round the arm or wrist; it is also applied to the string tying a packet or parcel; also with कन् added डोरक. दोष् रा-ड-पृषो ।
